scope: 10 distinct sample records manually judged using English-Chinese semantics and V2 ledger WordNet candidates; NOT Kaikki-enhanced, NOT a completed 181/300 batch
source_kaikki_status: verified original identified, individual entries not retrieved

entries.item_specific_reason: implement (verb) can mean 实施/执行; 落实条约 is a narrower contextual translation, while implement (noun)=工具/器具. Must preserve separate POS and check legal sentence.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 实施/执行（动词通用义）；落实条约仅在条约执行语境下使用

entries.source_zh_variants: 查找附近地点或服务的网络搜索 | 本地搜索
entries.item_specific_reason: In local SEO, a search for nearby businesses/services; in software, searching local device/data. 中文'本地搜索'涵盖两种意义, explanatory translation narrower.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 本地搜索；附近商户/服务搜索仅用于本地SEO语境

entries.source_zh_variants: 搜索结果可能存在的偏向 | 搜索结果的系统性偏向
entries.item_specific_reason: Search bias can be algorithmic/systematic ranking bias or user/cognitive bias in search behavior. 系统性 is not guaranteed by the bare expression.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 搜索偏差/搜索偏向；系统性偏差需有明确证据

entries.source_zh_variants: 延迟诊断 | 诊断延迟
entries.item_specific_reason: Both can express a diagnosis occurring later than appropriate. 延迟诊断 may also imply an actively deferred diagnostic action; 诊断延迟 emphasizes lateness. Source sentence decides.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 诊断延迟（事件/结果）；延迟作出诊断（动作）

entries.source_zh_variants: 支持网络 | 可以提供支持的人际关系网络
entries.item_specific_reason: In social/psychological care, support network refers to people/institutions offering practical/emotional support. In IT, network of support infrastructure possible. Avoid unqualified '支持网络' where ambiguity matters.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 社会支持网络/支持系统（人际场景）；技术支持网络（IT场景）

entries.source_zh_variants: 肉类温度计 | 测量肉内部温度的食品温度计
entries.item_specific_reason: Cooking utensil used to measure internal meat temperature. Short translation natural; longer is explanation, not a separate sense.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 肉类温度计；测量肉内部温度的温度计为解释

entries.source_zh_variants: 即时读数的食物温度计 | 快速测量食物内部温度的温度计
entries.item_specific_reason: Instant-read refers to rapid reading, not literally zero latency. Generic device need not exclusively measure food; cooking scene can narrow it.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: 快速读数温度计；烹饪语境可译快速测温的食品温度计

entries.item_specific_reason: 光 corresponds to noun light, 照亮 to verb light; both exist but not interchangeable senses. Check separate source member IDs before split recommendation.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: n. 光/光线；v. 点亮/照亮

entries.item_specific_reason: 焦点 (noun) vs 聚焦 (verb); also focus (noun) in attention sense=重点/关注点 and (verb)=集中注意. Optical vs cognitive usages need sentence-specific distinction.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: n. 焦点/重点；v. 聚焦/集中注意力

entries.item_specific_reason: approximate adjective=近似的/大约的, verb=估算/接近; 近似处理 is a specific procedural paraphrase rather than a broad verb gloss.
entries.proposed_zh_gloss: adj. 近似的/大约的；v. 估算/接近；近似处理须验证领域用法
